title: Learn to Have Better Balance and Prevent Falls as You Age
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: To age well, doctors say we should remember the importance of good balance.
sentences.zh: 医生说我们应该记住平衡的重要性。

sentences.en: It matters when you wash yourself, put clothing on and, generally, move around in your home and elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 当你洗衣服的时候,穿衣服,一般在家中和其他地方移动时,这很重要。

sentences.en: As we age, good balance permits us to live more independently.
sentences.zh: 随着我们的老化,良好的平衡使我们能够更加独立地生活。

sentences.en: Difficulties with balance can be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 平衡方面的困难可能是危险的。

sentences.en: The United States Centers for Disease Control reports that three million older people in America seek medical care for fall-related injuries each year.
sentences.zh: 美国疾病控制中心报告说,美国每年有300万老年人寻求与摔伤有关的医疗护理。

sentences.en: But we can prevent some falls, said Roopa Anmolsingh.
sentences.zh: 但Roopa Anmolsingh说,我们可以防止一些跌倒。

sentences.en: She is a geriatrician, a doctor who specializes in treating old people.
sentences.zh: 她是老年医学家 专门治疗老年人的医生

sentences.en: She is also the creator of the balance class program at Cleveland Clinic in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 她也是俄亥俄州克利夫兰诊所 平衡课程的创建者

sentences.en: She said that "Some people have a misconception that part of getting old is, you're going to fall.
sentences.zh: 她说,"有些人有一个误解, 老年的一部分是, 你会跌倒。

sentences.en: That's not true. You can control how you fall, or if you fall."
sentences.zh: 这不是真的,你可以控制你如何跌倒,或者如果你跌倒。"

sentences.en: To prevent falls, geriatricians say people should start asking themselves questions about their balance as early as 50 years old.
sentences.zh: 为了防止跌倒,老年病学家说人们早在50岁就应该开始问自己的平衡问题。

sentences.en: Here are the questions: Do I ever feel unsteady?
sentences.zh: 问题是:我曾经感到不稳吗?

sentences.en: If you feel unsteady, or lose balance, from time to time, ask your doctor to check all your body systems that can affect balance.
sentences.zh: 如果你感到不稳,或失去平衡, 时不时地,请医生检查 你所有的身体系统 可能影响平衡。

sentences.en: Along with muscle and bone problems, unsteadiness can also result from poor blood pressure, inner-ear problems, nervous system issues and more.
sentences.zh: 除了肌肉和骨骼问题之外,不安定还可能来自低血压、内耳问题、神经系统问题等等。

sentences.en: Maybe you do not have unsteadiness but wonder about your skill at balancing.
sentences.zh: 也许你没有不安定的状态 但想知道你的平衡技巧

sentences.en: You can test yourself easily and at home to find out if you need any medical intervention.
sentences.zh: 你可以很容易地在家中测试自己 以确定你是否需要任何医疗干预

sentences.en: Stand next to a wall or something that can provide support if needed.
sentences.zh: 站在墙边 或可以提供支持的东西,如果需要。

sentences.en: Raise one leg. Can you hold that position for 10 seconds?
sentences.zh: 抬起一条腿 你能坚持住吗?

sentences.en: Now try the other leg. If you can stand on each leg alone for 10 seconds, you should be fine, said Greg W.
sentences.zh: 试试另一条腿 如果你能单脚站上10秒

sentences.en: Hartley, a professor of physical therapy specializing in geriatrics at the University of Miami in Florida.
sentences.zh: 哈特利,佛罗里达迈阿密大学老年医学物理治疗教授

sentences.en: "If you can't do that, then you should probably go see a physical therapist," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说:"如果你做不到,那你也许应该去看理疗师"

sentences.en: A physical therapist treats people with conditions or injuries that affect body movement.
sentences.zh: 理疗师对人进行影响身体运动的条件或伤害治疗。

sentences.en: Another at-home test is called TUG, for "timed up and go." Hartley suggests doing this test with supervision.
sentences.zh: 另一个家用测试叫做TUG, 叫做"准时出发"。 哈特利建议用监督来做这个测试。

sentences.en: You begin the test from a seated position.
sentences.zh: 你从一个座位开始测试

sentences.en: Then, stand up and start a timer immediately.
sentences.zh: 那就站起来,马上启动计时器

sentences.en: Walk three meters, turn and walk back to your seat.
sentences.zh: 走三米,转身回到你的座位上

sentences.en: Stop the timer as soon as you sit down. If the test takes you longer to complete than 15 seconds, your risk for falling is very high.
sentences.zh: 你一坐下就停住计时器。如果测试需要超过15秒的时间完成,你跌倒的风险就非常高。

sentences.en: But, if you do it in 12 seconds or less, your fall risk is almost zero.
sentences.zh: 但是,如果你在12秒或更短的时间里做, 你的坠落风险几乎是零。

sentences.en: Also, The National Council on Aging offers an online set of questions to predict your risk of a fall.
sentences.zh: 此外,国家老龄问题委员会提供了一系列在线问题,以预测你跌倒的风险。

sentences.en: What can I do to improve balance? Because muscle mass lessens in most people during their 30s, geriatricians say the best way to keep good balance is to stay physically active throughout life.
sentences.zh: 如何改善平衡?因为30多岁时肌肉质量下降,老年医学家说保持平衡的最佳方式是终生保持身体活跃。

sentences.en: Anmolsingh says it is never too late to act on that advice.
sentences.zh: Anmolsingh说,就这个建议采取行动永远不会太迟。

sentences.en: Activities including tai chi and yoga are good for older adults because they involve controlled movements while shifting body weight.
sentences.zh: 包括泰吉和瑜伽在内的活动对老年人有好处,因为它们涉及在改变体重的同时有控制的移动。

sentences.en: There also are simpler exercises people can work into their everyday lives.
sentences.zh: 还有更简单的练习,人们可以在日常生活中工作。

sentences.en: Anmolsingh says standing on one foot while waiting in line at a store is good.
sentences.zh: 安莫辛格说单脚站着 在店里排队很好

sentences.en: Or, at home, sit down and stand up several times straight without using a support.
sentences.zh: 或者,在家里,坐下来 站好几次,不用支持。

sentences.en: Another easy exercise is the three-way leg lift.
sentences.zh: 另一件容易的动作是三路抬腿

sentences.en: Hold on to a support, then lift a leg to the front, then to the side and then to the back.
sentences.zh: 坚持住,然后抬起一条腿到前面, 然后在侧面,然后在背面。

sentences.en: How often should I do the exercises? The National Institute of Aging says people should spend at least 150 minutes per week in general physical activity to improve balance and overall health.
sentences.zh: 国家老龄问题研究所(National Agent of Angage)说,人们每周至少要花150分钟的时间参加一般的体育活动,以改善平衡和整体健康。

sentences.en: Hartley said exercises done on a usual basis help train the brain to react correctly when you start to fall.
sentences.zh: 哈特利说,通常练习 帮助训练大脑 以正确反应 当你开始下降。

sentences.en: "Just like an athlete needs to do repetition to train for a sport, you're doing repetition to train for everyday balance activities," he said.
sentences.zh: "就像运动员需要做重复 训练运动, 你正在做重复 训练日常平衡活动," 他说。

sentences.en: I’m Jill Robbins. Albert Stumm reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是Jill Robbins, Albert Stumm 为美联社报导了这个故事。

sentences.en: Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.
sentences.zh: 吉尔・罗宾斯改编了它 学习英语。
